scope: transport-only spatial sparsification at the frozen fused C2 split

perception_binding.checkpoint_load_scope: phase-3 bounded train-only GPU qualification only; frozen, eval mode, requires_grad=False
unmodified: FCOS classification, box regression and centerness scoring

c2_contract.channel_granularity: all 256 channels of a spatial cell are retained or dropped together

bitmask.order: cell i at byte i//8, bit 7-(i%8); MSB-first within a byte
bitmask.compression: none; fixed-order uncompressed bitmask is locked for this phase

values.order: retained cells in ascending row-major cell order
values.layout: all 256 FP32 channels of a retained cell contiguous

wire_format.decode: dense [256,112,192] with exact zeros in dropped cells
wire_format.primary_compression_ratio: actual serialized q payload bytes / actual serialized q=0 payload bytes
wire_format.raw_fp32_reference_note: 22020096 is the unframed raw tensor size, reported separately; the framed q=0 payload is NOT wire-byte-identical to it

q_contract.definition: q is the spatial drop fraction; drop_count = floor(q*N + 0.5); keep_count = N - drop_count
q_contract.selection: keep highest-scoring cells; ties prefer the lower row-major spatial index
q_contract.q0_behaviour: bypass ranking and sparse masking; return the validated input tensor object

ranker.final_layer_bias_rationale: a global scalar score offset is unidentifiable: it cannot change cell ranking, exact-cardinality selection or the hard mask, and listwise softmax distillation is invariant to it
ranker.init_rng_isolation: torch.random.fork_rng; the caller's global RNG state is restored

group_definitions.D: FCOS classification, box regression and centerness

teacher.normalization_scope: each valid group normalized independently before combination
teacher.invalid_group_handling: absent, zero-gradient and non-finite groups are recorded with a reason and excluded; never silently treated as valid supervision
teacher.gradient_mass: diagnostic only; raw pre-normalization L1 mass of each group importance map
teacher.task_losses: dense task-loss values retained separately for future train-only reference-scale construction
forbidden: RGB, radar, predictions or GT in the ranker runtime

q_aware.parity_note: q=0 is parity monitoring only and must not produce a ranker-training gradient
q_aware.objective: mean(valid masked task loss / frozen train-reference median for that task) + 0.1 * distillation loss
q_aware.reference_median_prohibition: no validation-derived or test-derived scale is allowed

optimization.augmentation_rationale: cached teacher maps must remain aligned with canonical frames

straight_through.q0: explicit identity bypass with no surrogate gradient

gradient_qualification.nonzero_gradient_required: every named trainable ranker tensor at least once across the completed window
post_step_checks: frozen perception parameters and buffers exactly unchanged

deferred_to_later_phases: fixed quantization and zstd at frozen C2 Z
AE128, AE64 and AE32 encoders and decoders at frozen C2 Z
selection vectorization, pending Phase-3 latency measurement
payload, UE, network, edge and end-to-end latency measurement
